[C1] . G A F#m Bm A heart that hides Your Word so that sin will not come in . Em A D D7 A heart that's undivided but one you rule and reign . G A F#m Bm A heart that beats compassion that pleases You my Lord . Em A Em A D A sweet aroma of worship that rises to Your throne
